question: do the provider-visible M4 payload bytes remain identical to the corrected pre-freeze version, apart from the unavoidable opaque identifier substitution?

method: a temporary read-only script imported the REAL functions — renderAvailableGovernedEvidence and GOVERNED_SOURCE_ID_SHAPE from the first-pass vNext module, redactCitationTokens from expert-prompt and CITATION_SHAPED_PATTERN from expert-contract.types — rendered the M4 governed evidence block before and after the substitution, and diffed them line by line.
